name: Watase Fuuka
source:
The second daughter and youngest member of the family.
A pretty girl with a somewhat smug face, she is active, emotional, and outspoken. A reliable and thoughtful person loved by her friends.

As the youngest of her siblings, she shows a spoiled side. But she is still kind-hearted and cares about her family

She is an excellent competitive swimmer, but her grades are lacking. Her brother helps her out with some of her bad marks.
